messages.subject: Indefinite number of textInput's
parts:
I want the user to have add an unlimited number of textInputs. The inputs are put together to form a matrix. Below is a snippet of my code.  I figured out how to add textInput's through an actionButton, but each time the actionButton is clicked, it resets the values in each textInput.  For example, the user would enter "House" in the first input, then click "Add Asset". Then the 2nd textInput, and they could enter "Car".  The matrix would then be ("House", "Car").  Right now, it clears "House" out of the first textInput, and the user has to re-enter it.  Thanks again!

--Server.R
      numAssets <- reactive({ 
        input$addAsset
        isolate({
          numAssets <- input$addAsset + 1
        })
        numAssets
      }) 

      output$Dynamic <- renderUI({
        n <- numAssets()
        L <- vector("list",n)    
        assetVector <- as.matrix(c(""))
        for(i in 1:n){
          L[[i]] <- list(textInput(inputId = paste0("mVariable",i), label = paste0("mVariable",i), value=assetVector[i]))
        }   
        print(assetVector)
        L
      })

--ui.R
               uiOutput("Dynamic"),
               actionButton('addAsset', "Add Asset"),

messages.subject: Indefinite number of textInput's
parts:
Hi,

You can create a reactiveValues object to store all values entered by the user and use this object to create your matrix.

see reactiveValues here: http://shiny.rstudio.com/reference/shiny/latest/

Best, Herman
